terms.auto_closeout: Automatic worker artifact generation/repair step before bundle validation.
terms.baseline_owner: Worker assigned to visual baseline update by default (B_worker).
terms.bundle: Per-agent output directory for a run.
terms.integrator: Worker that merges, validates, and reports only.
terms.ledger_watch: Z-integrator visibility step over run ledger and watch summary.
terms.optional_check: Validation check that does not block by default.
terms.scope_lock: File ownership contract for a worker.
